translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Asay bare wozanaan halchchee; shin likke zaaruu Med'inaa Godaappe beettee.
Asay ootsiyaa oosuwaa ubbay aw likke malatee; shin Med'inaa Goday koyiro dendduwaa k'ofaa yiggi s'eellee.
Ne ootsiyaawaa ubbaa hadaraa Med'inaa Godaw imma; yaatooppe, neeni halchcheeddawe polettana.
Med'inaa Goday med'd'eeddawaa ubbaa bare halchchoo med'eedda; haninttokka makkalanchchatuwaa wurssetsay bayetsaa.
Med'inaa Goday otorettiyaa ubbaa shenetee; unttunttu murettenan attikkino.
Aggena siik'uwaaninne ammanettiyaawaan nagaray atto geetettee; Asay Med'inaa Godaw yayyiyaawaan iitabaa ootsennan naagettee.
Asaa hametay Med'inaa Godaa nashechchiyaawaa gidooppe, he uraw bare morkkatuwaanakka saro de'anaadan, S'oossay ootsee.
S'illotetsan beettiyaa guutsabay wordduwaan demmiyaa daro wod'iyaappe keeka.
Asay bare wozanaan bare ootsanabaa halchchee; shin halchchuu Med'inaa Goday maaddina polettee.
Kaatii S'oossaappe akkeedda maatan pirddee; pirddiidde I balena.
Miizaanatuunne makkiyaa miishshatuu ammantsiyaawantta gidanaadan, Med'inaa Goday koyee; zal"iyaawaa ubbaan c'imuu de'ennaadan koyee.
Kaatetuu bayzzuwaa oosuwaa shenetiino; ayaw gooppe, unttunttu kawutetsaa araatay s'illotetsan ek'k'ee.
Kaatetuu s'illo ins's'arssan nashettiino; tumuwaa haasayiyaawanttakka dosiino.
Kaatiyaa hank'k'uu hayk'k'uwaa kiitanchchaa mala; shin aad'd'eeda eranchcha Asay hank'k'uwaa irs's'issanaw awuddashee.
Kaatiyaa som"ii pashikkooppe, hewe simmi de'uwaa. I nashshiyaawe bad'd'eesaa iraa ahiyaa shaariyaa mala.
Aad'd'eeda eratetsaa demmiyaawe work'k'aa demmiyaawaappe keeka; akeekaa demmiyaawe biraa demmiyaawaappekka aad'd'ee.
Suuretuu biyaa ogii iitay de'iyaasaappe haakuwaana aatsee; bare hemetaa naagiyaa uray bare shemppuwaa naagee.
Otoruwaa geeduwaa bashshay kaallee; ayyuwaa geeduwaakka kunddetsay kaallee.
Ayyiyaawanttuna zuppetiide, omooduwaa shaakki akkanaappe ashkke gidiide, hiyyeesiide de'iyaawe keeka.
Med'inaa Godaa k'aalaa loytsiide hayzziyaa uraw I ootsiyaawe ubbay injjetana; S'oossan ammanettiyaa uray anjjetteedawaa.
Bare k'ofaan aad'd'eeda eranchcha gideedda Asay akeekanchcha geetettee; lo"o k'aalay eratetsaa gujjee.
C'inc'c'a uraw eratetsay de'uwaa pulttuwaa mala; shin boozatuwaa seeriyaawe c'oo wodiyaa wurssiyaawaa.
Aad'd'eeda eranchcha Asay haasayanaappe kasetiide k'oppee; Asay akkiyaa haasayaa haasayee.
Lo"o k'aalay eessaa ililuwaadan mal"ee; bollaakka maaddeenne patsee.
Asaw suure malatiyaa ogii de'ee; shin wurssetsan hayk'k'oo gatsee.
Koshay Asay minniide ootsanaadan dentsetsee.
Iita Asay iitabaa halchchee; Aa haasayaykka s'uuggiyaa tamaa mala.
Geella Asay walassaa dentsee; zigiriyaa Asay ammanettiyaa laggetuwaa shaakkee.
Makkala Asay bare shooruwaa c'immee; lo"o gidenna ogiyaw I Aa kaaletsee.
Bare ayifiyaa sim"iyaa Asay geellabaa k'oppee; bare mettershshaa sa"iide manddiyaa Asay iitabaa polee.
Puulummeedda huup'ii bonchcho kallachchaa; hewekka beettiyaawe s'illo de'uwaa de'ina.
Wolk'k'aama asaa gidiyaawaappe, hank'k'ettanaw elleellenna asaa gidiyaawe lo"a; daro katamatuwaa oliide oyk'k'iyaawaappe, Asay bare huup'iyaa mooddiyaawe aad'd'ee.
Asay saamaa yeggee; shin Med'inaa Goday ubbabaa wurssetsaa k'achchee.
